objective: Exploratory census: for every product of two one-bit decorations, up to exchanging the factors and relabelling either, look for a periodic two-bit labelling of a listed crystal's cut that obeys the product's labelled law (the 11 domino-torus planes legal within two cuts at their first admitted levels and one more, the 26 mixed-orientation crystals at one and two cuts, tori of index 1 or 2), trying a crystal only where both factors admit it. Products that escape no listed crystal are the survivors.
status: Closed, supported (exploratory, TWO-BIT-20261108-001A-E001): of 139,656 classes of products of two one-bit decorations, 136,415 escape a listed crystal (88,961 first on a domino-torus plane, 47,454 on a mixed-orientation crystal) and 3,241 escape none of the 296 tests (646 with no test both factors admit, 2,595 with no joint labelling on the common ones).
title: Products of one-bit decorations against the known crystals
